description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a UI fragment that contains a LogView for displaying log messages and manages UI layout and interactions related to logs in an Android application.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that displays a log using LogView inside a ScrollView, handles view setup, layout configuration, and auto-scrolling when log text changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView UI components, setting layout parameters, styling, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy for the fragment, sets up the text watcher to auto-scroll on log updates.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within this fragment.
